# foreman_architecture (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "foreman_architecture" "x86_64" {
  name = "x86_64"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the architecture to look up.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `operatingsystem_ids` (Set of Number) Operating system IDs
